command.description: The cmd.exe command to execute (cmd syntax, not POSIX)

category.description: Optional self-declared risk; can only raise the approval requirement.

timeout_secs.description: Optional wall-clock timeout (seconds, up to 3600) for this command before it is killed. Use a larger value for long-running work (builds, test suites, solvers). Omitted or 0 runs without a deadline.
